consequence.statement: Responses whose backend does not set Content-Type no longer get an auto-detected Content-Type header unless the ContentType middleware is used.
consequence.remediation: Use the ContentType middleware to enable Content-Type auto-detection.

original.statement: In v3, Traefik no longer auto-detects the Content-Type header when the backend doesn't set it; the ContentType middleware must be used to enable auto-detection.

decision.reason: [ev-be4f90e8abf9] says that in v3 the Content-Type header is no longer auto-detected when the backend does not set it, and that the ContentType middleware turns auto-detection back on. The evidence does not say that anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured. Responses are still served, just without an inferred header, so this is behavior-change, which needs review, not a failure kind. The proposed statement and remediation (use the ContentType middleware) match the evidence.
